name: Dataprep Holdings Bhd
overview: Dataprep Holdings Berhad 今年主要动作是拟以 RM3.0 million 出售 Dataprep Payment Solutions Sdn. Bhd. 的 60% 股权，并完成约 RM11.0 million 的配售集资；此外公司更改财政年度结算日。
overview_en: Dataprep Holdings Berhad's main corporate action this year was the proposed disposal of 60% equity interest in Dataprep Payment Solutions Sdn. Bhd. for RM3.0 million, alongside the completion of a placement raising approximately RM11.0 million; the company also changed its financial year end.

segments.name: 支付解决方案与服务
segments.note: 公司拟出售该业务子公司 60% 股权。
segments.note_en: The company proposed to dispose of 60% equity interest in its payment solutions subsidiary, which will cease to be controlled by the company upon completion.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司就上述出售 60% 股权事项发布补充资料。
actions.text_en: The company issued additional information on the proposed disposal of the 60% equity interest.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司与 Mr. Ng Chee Chau 签订股份出售协议，以 RM3.0 million 现金出售 Dataprep Payment Solutions Sdn. Bhd. 的 60% 股权（9,540,600 股）。
actions.text_en: The company entered into a share sale agreement with Mr. Ng Chee Chau to dispose of 60% equity interest (9,540,600 shares) in Dataprep Payment Solutions Sdn. Bhd. for RM3.0 million in cash.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司完成配售集资并更改财政年度结算日。
segments.note_en: The company completed a placement fund-raising exercise and changed its financial year end.

actions.title: Change in Financial Year End
actions.text: 公司更改财政年度结算日。
actions.text_en: The company changed its financial year end.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 配售事项于 2026 年 5 月 22 日视为完成，共发行 104,218,000 股配售股份，筹集总毛额约 RM11.0 million。
actions.text_en: The placement was deemed completed on 22 May 2026, with 104,218,000 placement shares issued, raising total gross proceeds of approximately RM11.0 million.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 公司拟出售支付解决方案子公司 Dataprep Payment Solutions Sdn. Bhd. 的 60% 股权，交易完成后将退出该业务。
model_changes.text_en: The company proposed to dispose of 60% equity interest in its payment solutions subsidiary Dataprep Payment Solutions Sdn. Bhd., exiting the business upon completion.
